html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · June 21, 2022

On Jun 20, 2022, content creative cloud Aisheji (爱设计) (founded 2018) closed a multi-¥10M Series A2 led by Ceyuan Ventures, with AJA Fund and strategic LPs — 6th round — for AI/algo creative R&D and talent. “One body, two wings”: content+cloud engine (image/copy/video/H5/PPT editors) → C and B apps; content mid-platform for mid/large enterprises (finance, FMCG, new retail, chains). Hundreds of enterprise logos.

— END —
